items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Buster Bailey, and the interviewee (Stan Getz) responds by listing Buster as part of the 'core of Smacks band' and calling him a 'tremendous musician', but does not describe a direct personal or collaborative relationship with Buster Bailey himself.

ctx.x: Yes, he did. I felt he felt a little too confident.
Yeah, well that's what it really what it was (2).
Well, now how did these changes come about when Roy and Chu came in, what was the reason for that? Was Buster Baily in the band before they came in?
